intro: IBMR Gurgaon and SAITM both sit in Gurgaon, and this page compares their recorded BCA fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.
IBMR Gurgaon vs SAITM is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: IBMR Gurgaon vs SAITM for BCA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IBMR Gurgaon if its BCA programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose SAITM if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹1.02 lakh a year as tuition fees for IBMR Gurgaon's Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA). Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹78,500 a year as tuition fees for SAITM's Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA). Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, IBMR Gurgaon's 2023 figures are an average of ₹8 lakh and a highest of ₹15 lakh for Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA). These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
In our records, SAITM's 2021 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh for Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA). These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2023 and 2021, so the two packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for IBMR Gurgaon on this BCA page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for SAITM on this BCA page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Gurgaon, Delhi NCR. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: There is no universal winner in IBMR Gurgaon vs SAITM for BCA. Use the programme list, the official fee notice and the admission test to decide.
If one side is missing a quotable fee or a recent official placement year, do not fill the gap with a guess from another course or an older batch.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
